contracts.inputs: Signed Slack payload, workspace ID, two allowed channel IDs
contracts.outputs: Exact add or status command with source channel and parent thread
contracts.failures: Invalid signature rejects; wrong workspace/channel, bots and other text are ignored
contracts.retry: Pure routing; Slack retries carry the same message timestamp
contracts.invariants: No passive scans or cross-channel routing

contracts.inputs: Add command, explicit client/date and configured source mapping
contracts.outputs: Exactly one task or missing-detail prompt
contracts.sideEffects: Writes work item and optional default General workstream
contracts.failures: Ambiguous/missing required fields create no task
contracts.retry: Existing external Slack message ID prevents duplicate work
contracts.invariants: No inferred client or client document write

contracts.inputs: Status command and exact client name
contracts.sideEffects: Reads clients and work items; writes one reply ledger entry
contracts.failures: Unknown/ambiguous client gets safe choices; query failure does not fabricate status
contracts.retry: Unique command key prevents duplicate replies
contracts.invariants: Internal-only and dismissed work never appear

contracts.inputs: One command result and original channel/thread timestamp
contracts.outputs: One in-thread Slack reply or recorded failure
contracts.sideEffects: Posts to Slack and records delivery state
contracts.failures: Transport timeout is uncertain; do not blindly resend
contracts.retry: Unique command key and Slack client message ID limit duplicates
contracts.invariants: No cross-channel post or channel-wide broadcast
